title: Agora Arena
tagline: Create your own ultimate moves by voice.
description: Build a browser fighting game with Agora RTC voice chat and RTM multiplayer input synchronization. Players speak an ultimate move, OpenAI transcribes it, and Reactor FastH3 Omni generates a cinematic attack that both players can watch.
author: zicojiao
